g.text: Hardware Streaming Dataflow: 3D Graphics, 2D Blit, Systolic Matrix Acceleration, and Display Scanout
1. 3D Graphics Pipeline (Geometry ──> Setup & Raster ──> Fragment & Texture ──> Tile Blend & Cache Writeback)
2. 2D Blitter & Fast Memory Copy Pipeline (Fill / Copy / Format Swizzle / MSAA 4x Resolve)
• Parallel MSAA 4x Resolve (4-Sample Downsample Box Average without Stall)
• Fast Color Fill, Alpha-Over Blending, and Linear ↔ Tiled Texture Layout Transposition
3. Systolic Matrix Multiplication & Tensor Accelerator Pipeline (Streaming Compute)
4. Display Controller (DC) Scanout & Multi-Level Watermark Preemption Path (Tear-Free Display)
